searchText: Hello ! Not sure I'm asking it in the right channel : Will unstaking of ETH from the beacon chain be possible after the "Quick Merge" scheduled EOY/early 2022 ? Or this will only be possible after full release of ETH 2.0 (sharding etc..). Trying to evaluate the opportunity cost of Staking right know by guessing a safe minimum lockup period for staked ETH. Thanks ! No, withdraws won't be part of The Merge. I recommend against using the term "ETH 2.0". It is pretty amorphous and just refers to a bunch of different future features. The consensus switch (The Merge) is the next upcoming major change. Sharding is some undefined point in the future. Withdraws will *probably* arrive sometime between the two. I recommend expecting 1-2 year lockup *at least* when it comes to planning. . Thanks for the reply, well noted 👍 But will MEV fees be redirected to validators directly after The Merge (considering EIP-1559 passes without trouble before) or does it need more tweakings after the Merge to deploy it ? <@456226577798135808> scammer in my DM Sending unsolicited message 🔨
